software.name: Nextcloud
software.networkActivity: A Nextcloud server or hosted provider is required for synchronization; cached/offline files may remain locally accessible
software.pricing: Software is open source; hosting costs vary

privacyDetails.advertising: Depends on hosting/provider and server configuration; not inherent to the open-source client itself
privacyDetails.analytics: Depends on server/client configuration and deployment
privacyDetails.collected: The Android client connects to a user-selected Nextcloud server; what is collected depends on the server operator, enabled apps, logging, and external integrations.
privacyDetails.controls: Self-hosting, provider choice, server configuration, app permissions and enabled integrations provide different control points.
privacyDetails.deletion: Local cached copies and server-side files are distinct; server retention and backup policy depend on the operator.
privacyDetails.encryption: Transport/storage protections and optional encryption features depend on deployment; self-hosted does not mean universal end-to-end encryption.
privacyDetails.practicalImplications: Self-hosting can improve control, but privacy is determined by the actual server deployment, administrator, logs, enabled integrations, and encryption configuration.
privacyDetails.purpose: Synchronize, access and share files and related collaboration data with a Nextcloud server.
privacyDetails.recipients: The selected Nextcloud server operator and configured integrations can receive data; self-hosting changes who operates that infrastructure but does not inherently eliminate logging or metadata.
privacyDetails.sale: Depends on hosting/provider; not established by the open-source client source alone
privacyDetails.sharing: Sharing is user/server-policy controlled; external integrations and federated sharing can add recipients.
privacyDetails.tracking: Depends on server/client configuration and deployment

software.privacySummary: Self-hosting can give the operator control over storage and logs. Actual privacy depends on the chosen server and administrator.
